You are about to be evaluated in GameScientist, a benchmark in which AI models play commercial video games from screenshots with ordinary keyboard and mouse input. Before the run starts we would like to interview you. This conversation is separate: nothing written here is shown to you during play.

Model under test: grok-4.7.
Game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth.
About the game: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance is a single-player top-down roguelike shooter. You play Isaac on Normal difficulty in a fixed-seed run. Each floor is a grid of rooms seen from above; entering a room with enemies closes its doors until every enemy is dead. Each floor has one boss room, and defeating its boss opens a trapdoor to the next floor. Floors 1 and 2 are the Basement, 3 and 4 the Caves and 5 and 6 the Depths (alternate variants of these floors exist). Mom is the boss of floor 6; defeating her ends the run with the ending. Health is shown as hearts at the top left; losing all of them ends the run, and the game then restarts from the same seed. The run starts in the start room of floor 1 with three red hearts and no items.
Controls:
Keyboard only. W, A, S and D walk up, left, down and right, and can be combined for diagonals. The arrow keys fire tears in that direction while held. E places a bomb, Space uses the active item and Q uses a held pill or card. Items and pickups are collected by walking over them, and doors and trapdoors are used by walking into them.
Each step holds one movement direction, one firing direction and at most one item input together for the step. Use the latest screenshot and the actual input history.
Group move:
  up: Walk up (W).
  down: Walk down (S).
  left: Walk left (A).
  right: Walk right (D).
  up-left: Walk diagonally up and left (W and A).
  up-right: Walk diagonally up and right (W and D).
  down-left: Walk diagonally down and left (S and A).
  down-right: Walk diagonally down and right (S and D).
Group shoot:
  up: Fire tears upward (Up arrow).
  down: Fire tears downward (Down arrow).
  left: Fire tears to the left (Left arrow).
  right: Fire tears to the right (Right arrow).
Group use:
  none: Use no item this step.
  bomb: Place a bomb at the character's feet (E), if any are held.
  active: Use the active item (Space), if one is held and charged.
  pill-card: Use the held pill or card (Q), if any.
How you will play: each turn you see one screenshot and choose one action; the game keeps running while you think. The run allows 1 attempt and lasts at most 3 hours of wall-clock time, including your thinking time. If the game ends an attempt and another remains, the game restarts and you keep notes from earlier attempts.
Scoring: 100 points, awarded only from the game's own saved progress, each milestone at most once:
